card.name: Web page navigation and citation markers
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation at section headings or reference lines on web pages, such as 'Resources', 'references', 'Articles' after 'Related', and dates or year digits in citations.

modes.label: Link-section headings
modes.description: Heading words like Articles, Resources, references or Summary in related-content or reading-list sections.
modes.example: Must Read<< Articles>> Related to Diet and Nutrition in Crohn

modes.label: Dates and citation details
modes.description: Closing parenthesis, comma or year digit inside publication dates and source credits.

card.plain: It fires on web page furniture such as 'Related Articles' headings and dates in source credits, not on medical content.
